effects.printed_clause: Banish all other Spell/Trap Cards on the field, then your opponent draws cards equal to the number banished. During the End Phase of this turn, return all your opponent's cards banished by this effect to the GY. You can only activate 1 Tome of Eclipse per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The activation requires at least one other field Spell/Trap and legal opponent draw capacity, banishes every currently eligible other Spell/Trap face-up, counts the cards actually banished, retains the opponent-owned subset, draws the actual count, and registers a one-shot End Phase operation that returns the still-banished opponent-owned cards to the GY through Necrovalley. SetCountLimit(1,id+EFFECT_COUNT_CODE_OATH) enforces one activation per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Collects all on-field Spell/Traps, banishes them face-up in one operation, and derives a follow-up quantity from Duel.GetOperatedGroup after successful removal.
Registers a one-shot End Phase continuous effect and resolves a draw whose quantity is computed from cards successfully processed earlier in the turn.
Retains a banished-card group across phases with KeepAlive/LabelObject and later returns still-related banished cards at the scheduled phase.
